messages:
Jordan: Quick check — we're migrating the search-prod namespace off long-lived k8s AWS creds and onto projected serviceAccount tokens + IRSA. Planning to annotate indexer-sa with the role ARN and remove the opaque secret afterwards. Anyone seen surprises with secrets-store-csi + projected tokens?

Sasha: Which SA name exactly? indexer-sa in search-prod? Also are you switching existing deployments or new jobs only?

Jordan: Yep indexer-sa in search-prod. We'll first create IAM role with trust to the cluster OIDC provider, annotate the SA: `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/search-indexer-role`. Then update the deployment to rely on the projected token (no env creds). New jobs first in staging.

Mike: FWIW watch the CSI driver mounts. I hit a case where secrets-store-csi + projected token mounts interfered during rollout — the CSI driver expects to refresh the mount and the projected token path can shift permissions. Adding fsGroup on the pod helped in my case. Also confirm the CSI driver version; older drivers didn't handle subPath+projected tokens well.

Jordan: Good call. Example pod snippet we're planning to use (staging):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: indexer-sa
  namespace: search-prod
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/search-indexer-role
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: search-indexer
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: indexer-sa
      containers:
      - name: indexer
        image: ghcr.io/redwood/search-indexer:staging
        env: []
        volumeMounts:
        - name: secrets-store
          mountPath: /mnt/secrets
      volumes:
      - name: secrets-store
        csi:
          driver: secrets-store.csi.k8s.io
          readOnly: true
```

Sasha: Looks right. Two extra things: 1) Keep the old secret in TF/state until rollout passes. Remove from code/state in a follow-up so CI won't accidentally re-create. 2) Make sure the cluster OIDC provider exists and the IAM role's trust policy references the correct audience (`sts.amazonaws.com` + OIDC sub).

Kevin: Also, projected token TTLs matter — default token TTL is 1h for K8s tokenRequest. For IRSA, STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity session duration can be up to the role max (set by role's MaxSessionDuration). If you need longer lived sessions, set MaxSessionDuration on the IAM role and configure callers accordingly. For typical indexer workloads 1h is fine.

Jordan: Re: terraform: plan will create the IAM role and annotate SA via `kubernetes_service_account` resource. Do we want `lifecycle { ignore_changes = ["secrets"] }` anywhere or handle secret removal manually?

Mike: I prefer manual removal from state after verifying traffic in staging. Then a separate PR to delete the secret resource. Avoid lifecycle ignores unless you're sure.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: infra/iam plan finished for branch/irsa-indexer (plan id 9342) — 1 to add, 0 to change, 1 to delete.

Jordan: Thanks — plan looks sane. I'll do staged rollout: annotate SA + create role -> deploy to staging -> validate logs/metrics and CSI mount stability -> then prod rollout and finally remove TF secret. Will ping here when staging green.

Sasha: If you need someone to pair on the prod cutover ping me. Also add a short runbook note about how to revert to the opaque secret if something breaks.

Jordan: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Kevin: One last heads-up — update the CI image-builder IAM policy if it relied on the old secret. Might be a separate ticket.

Jordan: noted, opening follow-up ticket for CI policy check.
